items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: he is a friend of mine, a dear friend

ctx.x: Could we get a Xeroxed copy of that for me?

Yes, I have it. I have everything that I have ever done, when it was done, the musicians on the date. I haven't seen anything like that. I think we talked about this before, Pat. I haven't seen anything like this in the States. But this guy got ahold of it, and he is a friend of mine, a dear friend, and he is one person in the business that is so knowledgeable. I mean he actually follows up and has knowledge on people, and records to prove, you know. This is his life. He has a little house by the old river bed…
And he's a member of -- is he the founder also of the Society for Recorded Music?
